report.narrative: Part of a warehouse on Dudley Lane has collapsed. About 5 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet. Someone is trapped. Debris is still coming down.
Heat and crowding at a gathering on Smith Boulevard, many feel faint. About 5 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet.
Caller reports a crash involving several vehicles on Mcbride Avenue. About 7 people are hurt. 3 look badly hurt. Flames and smoke are visible.
Chemical leak reported near James Way, caller can smell fumes. About 5 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet. There is a strong chemical smell.
